title: Multiple Classes – Feature Flag OFF – Lesson Creation – Class Field Shows Single-Select Only
description: BR-39 — Decision Table (Deep) — Validates that with the feature flag disabled, lesson creation shows a single-select Class field and multi-class selection is not possible.
preconditions: - SF org: Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c = FALSE (flag OFF)\n- Course "Test Course MC" with multiple classes\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to SF Lessons and click "New Lesson"
2. Set Teaching Method=Group, Course=Test Course MC
3. Locate the Class field
4. Attempt to select more than one class
5. Select one class and save the lesson
steps_result:
1. Lesson form opens
2. Teaching Method and Course set
3. Class field is single-select (not multi-select)
4. Only one class can be selected; multi-select not available
5. Lesson saved with single class

title: Multiple Classes – Feature Flag OFF – Existing Multi-Class Lesson – Displays as Single Class
description: BR-39 — Decision Table (Deep) — Validates that disabling the feature flag causes an existing multi-class lesson to display as a single class on SF and BO.
preconditions: - SF and BO flags initially ON\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-Flag" has 2 LSC records: Class Alpha and Class Beta\n- Flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c can be toggled
steps_actions:
1. With flag ON, read Class field on SF Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Flag"
2. Turn Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c to FALSE
3. Navigate to SF Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Flag"
4. Read the Class field
5. Navigate to BO Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Flag"
6. Read the Class field in BO
steps_result:
1. Class shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
2. Flag now OFF
3. SF Lesson Detail displayed
4. Class shows single class (multi-class display reverted)
5. BO Lesson Detail displayed
6. BO also shows single class

title: Multiple Classes – Feature Flag Cycle – Flag ON Then OFF Then ON – Multi-Class Lesson Restores Full Display
description: BR-39 — State Transition Testing — Validates that toggling the flag OFF then back ON restores full multi-class display without data loss.
preconditions: - SF org; Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c currently ON\n- Lesson "Lesson MC-Flag" has 2 LSC records: Class Alpha and Class Beta\n- Flag can be toggled
steps_actions:
1. With flag ON, confirm "Lesson MC-Flag" shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"
2. Turn flag OFF and confirm display reverts to single class
3. Turn flag back ON
4. Navigate to SF Lesson Detail for "Lesson MC-Flag"
5. Read the Class field value
6. Confirm LSC records still exist in the related list
steps_result:
1. Both classes displayed
2. Single class shown (flag OFF)
3. Flag now ON
4. Lesson Detail displayed
5. Class field shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta" (both classes restored)
6. 2 LSC records still present (not deleted by the flag toggle)
